query:
SELECT
            session_id                          AS "session_id!",
            MIN(created_at)                     AS "created_at!",
            MAX(created_at)                     AS "last_used_at!",
            MAX(expires_at)                     AS "expires_at!"
        FROM refresh_tokens
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND revoked_at IS NULL
          AND expires_at > NOW()
        GROUP BY session_id
        ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC
